title: Catalog enrichment with validated structured output
scenario: Kestrel onboards 4,000 supplier products a season from messy free-text feeds. Build the nightly batch that turns them into structured attributes with a model, publishes only what the supplier text supports, and routes the rest to human review, without re-billing unchanged items or blowing the budget.
task: Pydantic contract with taxonomy, lengths and ranges; retry once with the validation error
Grounding checks: materials, colors, weights and capacities with unit conversion
Banned and conditional claims, low confidence, review queue with reasons
Idempotent re-runs keyed by SKU and source hash; a per-batch cost cap
acceptance: At most two model calls per item; the retry carries the error
Invented attributes caught; 45 qt is 42.6 L, not 45 L
Unchanged feed re-run makes zero model calls
Cost cap stops the batch and lists skipped items
